Langkawi is made up of 99 islands and the main island is Pulau Langkawi. This documentary enables the viewers to fully explore and see the whole island and its many legends like the infamous Mahsuri Tomb, Seven Wells (Telega Tujuh), Pregnant Maiden Lake (Pulau dayang Bunting), etc. In the comfort of your home, you can have a birds eye-view from the top of Gunung Raya or experience Island Hopping. You can also plan your travel to coincide with the LIMA air show or the Le Tour de Langkawi. Other places of interest is to go for a Mangrove Tour and see eagles feeding or have an experience inside the Bat Cave, but do not forget to visit the pristine and beautiful beaches like Pantai Tanjng Rhu.
